title: Summary: Commands and Help
objective: Print a command's verb, its help name, and the name of a command found by search, in three lines.
hint: Three Write-Output lines. Use $((Get-Command Remove-Item).Verb), $((Get-Help Clear-Host).Name), and $((Get-Command -Verb Set -Noun Content).Name). Put Verb:, Help for:, and Found: in front of them, with a space after each.
